summary: Customer needs help accessing loan balance online.

intents.keywords: I tried checking my ... account not found help.
issues: Customer unable to access loan account online
reasons (identified by agent): Account not linked to the online portal
actions of agent: Agent asked for loan account number.
Agent confirmed the account was not linked.
Agent offered to link the account to the portal.
Agent offered to send login instructions.
intents.resolution: Agent will link the account and send login instructions.

intents.keywords: Ok but I am ... will it be easy?
issues: Customer expresses concern about ease of using online portal
Customer states they are not good with online things
reasons (identified by agent): Customer's lack of familiarity with online portals
actions of agent: Agent reassured the customer that it is very simple.
Agent offered to send a guide.
Agent offered further assistance via phone call.
intents.resolution: Agent provided reassurance and offered a guide and further assistance.
